title: Phase 0 — tell the truth about what the factory is
description: docs/design/cloud-factory.md:3-4 says 'Status: design exploration. Nothing here is implemented.' It is ~30k lines of production TypeScript, 13 applied D1 migrations, a live deployed Worker, and runs that cost real money. Anyone reading only the doc concludes nothing exists. Fix the header and add a short status section stating what is built, what is deployed, and what is written-but-never-run (repo-wiki/phase-2-live-verification.md records Phase 2 code as unit-tested but never exercised in the deployed factory). Smallest change in the project and the one currently misleading every reader.
acceptance_criteria: docs/design/cloud-factory.md no longer claims nothing is implemented; it states what is built, what is deployed, and what is unverified, each with a pointer to evidence. No code changes.
closed_reason: Completed: rewrote the cloud-factory.md status header. It claimed 'design exploration, nothing here is implemented' above ~29.5k lines of production TypeScript, 13 applied D1 migrations and a live deployed Worker. Now states what is built, what is verified against real runs, and what is written-but-never-exercised (Phase 2 observability, 404 on the live Worker per repo-wiki/phase-2-live-verification.md), plus a pointer to the extraction spec. Done directly rather than planned as an epic — it was a one-line problem wearing an epic's clothes.
